files.reached: CUDA_DEFINES, the first thing every carried kernel's preamble emits, and G and CP in the flux-to-heating conversion.  The highest-value pin in this file: it reaches the assembled source of every carried kernel

record_module, called by the carried loader on every compile; it files a second, differing image under a deterministic suffix rather than replacing the first, which is what lets the carried and engine loaders coexist under one manifest root

DEFAULT_COLUMN_CHUNK, radiation_enabled, radiation_scheme_ids, RunConfig and SASE_PBL_SCHEME.  RunConfig IS constructed in carried npref, twice, inside its reference-state builders; no door of this package and no test calls those, and the 308 differing lines are inside the class they build

DTYPE, DomainState and the constants wdm6/sase read.  The DomainState constructor and init_at_rest are reached only from the same two reference-state builders in carried npref, which is where all 100 differing lines land
BaseState, VerticalCoord and rebalance_hydrostatic, bound at module scope by staying state.py
EXTERNAL_MARGIN_BYTES, device_memory_probe_reason, device_memory_probe_subprocess and MEASURED_LOCAL_MEMORY_PROFILE, which carried ntiedtke reads for its SM count
WRF_RRTMG_TO_RTE_RRTMGP and WRF_RRTMG_TO_RTE_RRTMGP_V1, two string tokens carried rrtmgp binds
outside_vertical_bounds and refuse_vertical_levels, bound at module scope by carried ysu.  Nothing in this package binds MAX_RRTMGP_LAYERS, and carried rrtmgp does not reach this file
_model_clock_dt, imported at module scope by carried gf
the validation-flag ledger carried ysu and carried rrtmgp read and write.  NOT gpuwm/core/health.py, which differs and is not reached
rrtmgp_data_dir and require_companion_member, called by carried rrtmgp at MODULE scope: the companion data wheel is an import requirement of the physics driver, not merely a run requirement
NO_LOCAL_GPU_ENV and no_local_gpu, read by the native suite
merge_mynn_bl_clouds, mynn_bl_cloud_active and wrf_itimestep; the package runs icloud_bl 0 so the merge is inert, but carried rrtmgp imports it at module scope
rimed_ice_constants, which is what morr_rimed_ice = 1 selects; bound at module scope by carried morrison and carried npref
MicrophysicsDiagnostics and its siblings, reached only through morrison.apply, which this package never calls
the reflectivity constants carried npref's mirrors read
bell_hill, reached only from carried npref's reference-case builders
WDM6_NUMBER_SPECIES, bound at module scope by staying state.py
rimed_ice_constants for the WSM6 mirrors; imports wdm6_constants and carried npref at module scope
E_MIN, bound at module scope by staying state.py
the LETKF eigensolver.  jacobi_eigh.cu is identical too, so the one kernel the assimilation touches compiles through the ENGINE's loader and needs no carry
gaspari_cohn and the LETKF entries this package's assimilation imports; the filter runs on the engine unchanged

the ShinHong passenger inventory, its TKE floor and its launchers.  This model runs YSU, so they are bound at import and never called

the carrier-source tokens, CarrierContract, CarrierContractError and consumer_carriers, which every radiation call in this model goes through. wrf_solar_geometry, imported inside the analytic COSZEN provider a radiation-free run needs, and DudhiaShortwaveRadiation at ra_sw=1.  This model runs RRTMGP with radiation active
RRTMDudhiaRadiation, imported inside the radiation selector at ra_lw=ra_sw=1.  The native adapter admits radiation='rrtmgp' only, which is why its 83 differing lines are not this model's physics

RRTMGLegacyRadiation, imported inside the radiation selector at ra_lw=ra_sw=4 with the legacy variant.  The native adapter admits radiation='rrtmgp' only, which is why its 157 differing lines are not this model's physics

the NSSL-2 default hooks, imported beside the contract at mp_physics=18.  The native adapter admits microphysics='morrison'
pin_absent_nssl2_fields, imported beside the contract at mp_physics=18.  The native adapter admits microphysics='morrison'
load_lookup_table_1 and p3_table_root, imported inside carried rrtmgp's P3 effective-radius path, which only a P3 run reaches
run_mpas_column_batch, served through carried physics' module-level __getattr__ for the hexagonal line's column batch; no door of this package asks for that name
update_diagnostics, imported inside carried npref's two reference-state builders.  Nothing in this package or its suite calls them, which is where all 26 differing lines live
